show.description: A brilliant young doctor’s perfect life hides a haunting past — a broken childhood, a father destroyed by a ruthless marriage, and a mother whose greed turns love into tragedy. Ek Mehenga Divorce is an emotional rollercoaster tracing how one costly divorce shatters generations, leaving behind scars deeper than any wound.
